doc: fused island arrangement (multi-crop cross-view fusion, 2026-07-25) converted to plan-grid layout data
sources: fused islandArrangement (c1 + c2 crop passes, cross-view locked)
reference/_archive/district3d/cand-topdown-height-1x.png (1px = 1 tile, sampled programmatically for mass arbitration)
src/game/island/cand/cand-spec.json (FORMAT + lift/level conventions ONLY; its geometry is the wrong old layout)

transform.note: the machine height map is already 120x96 = 1px/tile true plan (north = row 0). Grid coords below = heightmap coords shifted (-8,+3) so the island body sits ~x14..110 (requested band x8..112). Painted cand-1 source-fractions were used for adjacency/level structure; the height map arbitrated plan positions of the four large masses (volcano, terrace block, mole curl, lighthouse knob) per the fusion's trust boundary.

grid.frame: +x east, +y SOUTH (row 0 = north edge), origin NW

lifts.rule: terrain uses integer level * stepPx (20); STRUCT px lifts override wherever a structure exists
lifts.levelStory: sea L0 -> pier 14 / mooring strip 12 -> continuous lower quay 24 -> middle promenade 58 (east arm only) -> plaza + upper promenade 92 -> tudor row street + NE house upper story 116

tileLevels.name: sea
tileLevels.provenance: single waterline datum; foam-at-base in 10+ observations; the SW dark wedge = painted water shading, NOT geometry (fusion conflict resolved)

tileLevels.name: cove-shallows
tileLevels.provenance: scalloped foam + 3-step depth ramp off the west cove: c1-r1c0 x2, c1-r2c0 x2

tileLevels.name: basin
tileLevels.provenance: inner harbor basin (dark teal) enclosed by quay W/N, pier, mole inner face E/S: c1-r1c3 x2, c2-r0c2 x2 cross-view | fix2: enclosure east (+23,-29) per judge (drum -> ~86%/62% of bbox)

tileLevels.name: island-hull
tileLevels.provenance: the island BODY under everything built: organic diamond traced from the machine height map (land = v>=17 over the 13-14 sea plane, shifted (-8,+3)); encloses every land region with 1-3 tile margin; the SE bay is carved along the basin poly (y64 line x56-95 + x56 west face) and the harbor mouth stays open sea SW of the mole; the mole/curl/drum are built structures, deliberately OUTSIDE the hull (foam both flanks); the ship blob raw x4-22/y43-62 is a prop, excluded; west edge pulled to x11 and south cove edge to y69 so cove-shallows keeps its foam fringe | fix2: E/NE lobe pulled to x<=96 north of y40 (bite carve v1)

tileLevels.name: north-coast-rock
tileLevels.provenance: island rises from sea on all non-cove shores (cove = only walled-free water access, c1-r2c0 x2); reshaped from the straight strip into a coast band hugging the island-hull's north + east rim (2-4 tiles deep at the rim; jungle repaints its inner overlap) with a SE tail x93-95/y52-63 sealing the apron margin; heightmap north rim rows 1-9 + east rim taper

tileLevels.name: jungle-plateau
tileLevels.provenance: jungle canopy belt NW quadrant, painted (0.02-0.35, 0.15-0.55): c1-r0c0 x2, c1-r1c0 x2; jungle ground at-or-above plaza level per c2-r1c0; sits above the banded west cliff

tileLevels.name: jungle-north-band
tileLevels.provenance: canopy band wrapping the volcano foot, painted (0.35-0.75, 0.15-0.30); canopy occludes volcano base in both views (c2-r0c0/r0c1); extended south to y44 so the band truly WRAPS the cone (volcano + tudor + plaza repaint their own tiles over it) - without this the volcano sat in bare hull pockets | fix2: east extent trimmed to x72

tileLevels.name: volcano-slope-lower
tileLevels.provenance: cone flanks: c1-r0c1/r0c2 both passes, c1-r1c1/r1c2, c2-r0c0/r0c1 cross-view; PLAN position from heightmap gradient field (raw x68-108/y16-44), NOT the painted top-center apex (iso displacement, fusion-resolved) | fix2: recentered (-36,-7) + raised liftPx 130 per judge

tileLevels.name: volcano-slope-upper
tileLevels.provenance: ribbed gold/purple gully flanks; heightmap 8-9 band | fix2: recentered (-36,-7) + raised liftPx 185 per judge

tileLevels.name: volcano-rim
tileLevels.note: walkable terrain, deliberately unreachable (no trail evidenced in cand-1)
tileLevels.provenance: crater at painted src (345,47)+/-3px in 4 independent passes; smoke source marks summit; cone centroid uncertain +/-10 tiles (fusion conflict: saturated heightmap blob raw (97,38) likely includes the SE-drifting plume, so the cone was centered at the gradient's NW end) | fix2: recentered (-36,-7) + raised liftPx 240 per judge

tileLevels.name: crater
tileLevels.provenance: crater + ash plume, both c1-r0c1 and c1-r0c2 passes; ember/smoke only, no lake read | fix2: recentered (-36,-7) + raised liftPx 200 per judge

tileLevels.name: strata-cliff-west
tileLevels.provenance: banded strata cliff, painted (0.15-0.30, 0.43-0.60): c1-r1c0 x2 + c1-r1c1 x2 + c2-r1c0 x2 cross-view (identical striated ravine top-down); orange/rust + purple-brown diagonal bedding

tileLevels.name: strata-ledge
tileLevels.provenance: intermediate ledge with two small palms + bright grass lips (c1-r1c0, c2-r1c0); one of >=2 terrace levels between beach L0 and plateau

tileLevels.name: cove-sand
tileLevels.provenance: west beach cove crescent, painted (0.08-0.31, 0.50-0.70): c1-r1c0 x2, c1-r2c0 x2, c1-r2c1 x2; sand meets sea at grade, NO wall anywhere (both r2c0 passes)

tileLevels.name: cove-hummock
tileLevels.provenance: palm hummock with yellow-green rim, painted (0.10-0.20, 0.47-0.57); lone palm socket nearby at grid ~(26,62)

tileLevels.name: quay-wall-outcrop
tileLevels.provenance: great quay wall founded on a natural rock outcrop at its west end, painted (0.32-0.38, 0.55-0.68) (c1-r1c1 x2); masonry never touches the beach - built harbor and wild coast split at this seam

tileLevels.name: town-plaza
tileLevels.provenance: raised market plaza terrace, painted (0.27-0.55, 0.42-0.60): c1-r1c1 x2 + c2-r0c0/r0c1/r1c0/r1c1 cross-view (identical awning palette); heightmap mid-gray terrace block; manor/bell-tower socket on its north side (strongest cross-view lock in the fusion); flagstone with dashed border trim

tileLevels.name: plaza-bastion
tileLevels.provenance: great quay wall convex corner, painted ~(0.45,0.62): two lit tan-masonry faces meet here, dashed coping, corner lantern ON the rim; wall tallest (2.3-2.5 figure heights) just west of the corner where sea reaches its footing and the paw-sail ship moors hull-to-wall at L0 (c1-r1c1 x2, c2-r1c0/r1c1); optional detail: small arched recess/anchor fixture in the SE face (weak single claim, c1-r1c1 pass 1 only)

tileLevels.name: upper-promenade
tileLevels.provenance: east-arm upper promenade with stalls/lamps, painted (0.47-0.68, 0.38-0.50); SAME datum as the plaza (fusion: plaza/upper promenade = L2), contiguous at the x60-64 seam - no ramp needed

tileLevels.name: tudor-row-street
tileLevels.provenance: half-timbered row (3 tudor houses, chimneys) on the town's highest street, painted (0.51-0.73, 0.28-0.43), silhouetted against sky: c1-r1c2 x2, c2-r0c1 x2, c1-r0c2 x2 (roofs at ridge line); houses = later sprites (empty-stage law)

tileLevels.name: middle-promenade
tileLevels.provenance: middle promenade with wall-side stalls, painted (0.55-0.68, 0.52-0.62), below the tall gray retaining wall: c1-r1c2 x2 + c2-r0c1/r1c1 cross-view (same wall, same stall palette, same lamp positions); L1.5 pinned to 58px between quay 24 and terrace 92 (fusion gap bridged)

tileLevels.name: arch-tunnel
tileLevels.note: bridge tiles; scene-transition trigger on innermost (y52) row; round-topped, person-passable, dark interior
tileLevels.provenance: strongest-class cross-view match: c1-r1c2 x2 at painted (0.60,0.565) AND c2-r0c1 x2 + c2-r1c1 x2 at the identical wall station; arch base level with the middle promenade

tileLevels.name: quay-lower
tileLevels.provenance: continuous L1 lower working quay, painted (0.44-0.62, 0.62-0.75), continuous around the elbow with the stair-foot apron (fusion: the L's entire base is ONE walkable surface); cargo/noticeboard/fish-table/boat-hull/bollards = sprites (c2-r1c0 x2, c1-r1c1/r2c1); ladder at SW rim hints an unbuilt sub-level (fusion conflict, left unbuilt)

tileLevels.name: mooring-strip
tileLevels.provenance: slightly-lower mooring strip at the ship, given by the minor 3-4 step band painted (0.31-0.36 x, 0.60-0.64); ship sprite floats against the bastion's tall south face just east of here

tileLevels.name: ne-house-terrace
tileLevels.provenance: east hillside house terrace stack (quay apron -> pale stone terrace with arched openings -> timber house above), painted (0.69-0.75, 0.26-0.47): c1-r0c3 x2 + c1-r1c3 x2, c2-r0c2 cross-view; heightmap bright spot raw (100-103,50-51); timber house = sprite at 116 datum; possible extra sub-terrace here (c2-r0c1 two-stacked-levels read, unresolved)

tileLevels.name: headland
tileLevels.note: walkable top, deliberately unreachable: sheer shaded drop straight to sea on all water sides, no access read in any crop
tileLevels.provenance: grassy palm headland between east waterfront and mole root, painted (0.75-0.79, 0.39-0.47): c1-r1c2 x2 + c2-r0c2 x2 cross-view (grassy top, two palms, tan-brown cliff, white surf line)

tileLevels.name: headland-neck
tileLevels.provenance: rocky neck sealing the by-design-unreachable headland (sheer drop, no access read): bar y44-45 between jungle band and headland/terrace, spine x92-93 between the house terrace (92px) and the headland top (80px, a legal 12px step otherwise), foot x88-93/y54-55 closing the terrace-apron gap, east block x102-104 filling the hull margin; without it the headland leaks reachable

tileLevels.name: ne-quay-apron
tileLevels.provenance: quay apron below the NE house block, barrels + lamp terrace (c1-r0c3/r1c3, c2-r0c2); joins quay-lower at the shared x84-88 band and feeds the mole root | fix2: apron follows quay east end (+8,-2)

tileLevels.name: breakwater-walk
tileLevels.provenance: curved stone mole, root painted (0.73-0.77, 0.50-0.52): c1-r1c3 x2 + c1-r2c3 x2 + c2-r0c2 x2; PLAN course from heightmap raw column x96-101/y58-87; lit top walk ~1 wall-height above sea, coursed inner face, foam both flanks; outer (E) lip = low parapet, LOW CONFIDENCE (may be tonal split only, c1-r1c3 pass 2) | fix2: enclosure east (+23,-29) per judge (drum -> ~86%/62% of bbox)

tileLevels.name: breakwater-curl
tileLevels.provenance: the clockwise SW curl of the mole (SE then S then SW), matching the heightmap tail curving raw (100,70)->(90,90) | fix2: enclosure east (+23,-29) per judge (drum -> ~86%/62% of bbox)

tileLevels.name: mole-drum
tileLevels.note: round stepped drum, flat lighthouse SOCKET on top (lighthouse = sprite: tapered cream shaft, lit lantern, dark cap, 2 slit windows, drum-top door); mole TERMINATES here
tileLevels.provenance: terminal drum painted (0.84-0.87, 0.66-0.72); heightmap knob raw (88,90) arbitrates TERMINAL against c2-r0c2's continue-behind read (fusion: the c2 read is probably the drum's far rim); own foam ring | fix2: enclosure east (+23,-29) per judge (drum -> ~86%/62% of bbox)

tileLevels.name: pier-deck
tileLevels.note: wooden finger pier on visible pilings, lowest built walk level after the quay; built STRAIGHT - the T/L-arm read (c1-r2c2 x2) is unresolved, add the arm only if re-evidenced; family fallback = quay-stone recolor until a wood family exists
tileLevels.provenance: deck painted (0.66-0.78, 0.62-0.73) joining the quay near (0.665,0.62): c1-r1c2 x2, c1-r2c2 x2, c1-r2c3 x2 (pilings with ripple rings in all six passes), c2-r1c1 cross-view | fix2: enclosure east (+23,-29) per judge (drum -> ~86%/62% of bbox)

ramps.name: grand-stair
ramps.note: ONE single wide balustraded flight (15-22 treads, ramped parapets) - NOT the old spec's two-flight form
ramps.provenance: read independently 8 times: c1-r1c1 x2, c1-r1c2 x2, c1-r2c1 x2, c1-r2c2 x2 + cross-view c2-r1c1 x2; immediately SE of the wall corner, the L's hinge and main vertical connector

ramps.name: mooring-steps
ramps.provenance: minor 3-4 step band painted (0.31-0.36, 0.60-0.64) west of the wall corner

ramps.name: plaza-north-steps
ramps.provenance: INFERRED connector (fusion gap): c2-r1c0 puts jungle ground at-or-above plaza level and town buildings occlude the jungle, but no stair was read; jungle L6 = 90px under the engine lift law (NOT 120 - min(L,3)*20+max(0,L-3)*10), so the seam is a 2px kiss, treads nearly flat

ramps.name: tunnel-approach
ramps.provenance: arch base level with the middle promenade (cross-view lock); flat approach, trigger fires inside the tunnel

ramps.name: promenade-steps
ramps.provenance: INFERRED utility steps (fusion gap): stalls + figures populate the middle promenade but no stair to it was read in any crop; placed at the arm's NE end away from the locked arch/stair stations

ramps.name: tudor-steps
ramps.provenance: INFERRED utility steps (fusion gap): the highest street must join the upper promenade; no stair read - small step-flight, position provisional

ramps.name: pier-steps
ramps.provenance: pier joins the quay near painted (0.665,0.62); deck slightly above water on piles

ramps.name: mole-junction
ramps.provenance: small stepped junction where the quay narrows into the mole (c2-r0c2); walk rides 6px above the quay deck

ramps.name: mound-step
ramps.provenance: drum is a stepped platform (c1-r1c3/r2c3, c2-r0c2)

ramps.name: ne-terrace-steps
ramps.provenance: INFERRED (fusion gap): the three-level NE stack (quay apron -> stone terrace -> timber house) is read (c1-r0c3 x2, c1-r1c3 x2) but no stair; the arched quay-level openings are facade, not proven access; was authored INVERTED (24 at the terrace, 92 at the apron) - flipped to descend terrace(92,N)->apron(24,S) and stretched to 5 rows so treads land at 11.33px under the 12px step law

ramps.name: corridor-upper
ramps.provenance: a grass corridor descends through the banded cliff toward the hummock (c1-r1c0 x2, c2-r1c0 x2); upper leg, exact treads inferred; starts at y40 because strata-cliff-west owns the jungle's y40-41 rows - the ramp must bore through the cliff lip to reach jungle ground at y39

ramps.name: corridor-lower
ramps.provenance: lower leg of the same corridor, landing beside the palm hummock

spriteSockets.name: manor
spriteSockets.note: manor/church: square bell tower + pyramidal spire + pennant, chimney, columned balcony, arched door, hanging sign, porch up a short railed step-flight; 2-3 stories + tower clear above canopy (tallest built point, heightmap small bright cluster)

spriteSockets.name: plaza-stalls
spriteSockets.note: stall cluster painted (0.40-0.54, 0.40-0.56): tan, red/green, teal/white, black/white, green/white awnings; torch + lamp posts on the rim

spriteSockets.name: corner-lantern
spriteSockets.note: lantern exactly on the convex wall corner

spriteSockets.name: ship
spriteSockets.note: paw-print-sail two-master, hull-to-wall at L0 against the bastion south face; heightmap leaf blob raw x4-22/y43-62 confirms it floats (prop, never terrain)

spriteSockets.name: ne-timber-house
spriteSockets.note: timber story over the pale stone terrace; palm with red banner at the lip ~(88,46); island's highest NE silhouette

spriteSockets.name: quay-props
spriteSockets.note: cargo clusters, noticeboard post, fish vendor table, skeletal boat hull, crane/prow beam, ladder at SW rim (sub-level below = unresolved, NOT built)

spriteSockets.name: ledge-palms
spriteSockets.note: two small palms on the strata ledge

spriteSockets.name: boats
spriteSockets.note: rowboats, canopied boat, moored sailboats; crowds/gulls/lantern rims all later sprites
